notes: Formally launched by President Marcos on 23 Apr 2025 (Context.ph, https://context.ph/2025/04/23/president-marcos-leads-launch-of-350m-vitro-data-center/), described on 28 Jul 2025 as the country's 'largest and first AI-ready hyperscale data center': 50MW, 4,500+ racks, TIA-942 Rated 3.
